hero.headline: Put AI workers to work.
hero.body: Audoryn gives your organization one place to define AI workers, assign them real jobs, connect your tools and decide exactly what they may do.

typing.template: Every action in {place} is checked before it runs.

activity.headline: Every action leaves a trace.
activity.body: Requests, decisions and results arrive in one stream your team can inspect.

records.policy: Destructive repository actions are not granted

decision.headline: AI can propose. Audoryn decides what happens next.
decision.body: Before an AI worker touches an external system, its request meets checks the model cannot rewrite.

checks.label: Agent identity confirmed
checks.detail: A separate identity, inside the right organization

checks.label: Capability declared
checks.detail: Post a message to an approved channel

checks.label: Policy evaluated
checks.detail: Messages to leadership need a reviewer

allow.label: Allow
allow.title: The action proceeds.
allow.body: Identity, capability, risk and policy all pass, so the request reaches the provider.
allow.note: Only an allowed request can call the provider.

review.label: Hold for review
review.title: The action waits for a person.
review.body: The run pauses. A named reviewer sees the request and its context, then approves or declines.
review.note: Approval covers this exact action only.

deny.label: Deny
deny.title: The action stops here.
deny.body: The request is blocked at the gateway and the provider is never called.
deny.note: Missing or uncertain authority fails closed.

record.summary: Request, checks, decision, reviewer and result kept together in one record.

product.headline: An operating system for your AI workforce.
product.body: Create workers, give them real jobs, connect your tools and supervise the moments where human judgment matters.

items.title: Create workers
items.body: Give each AI worker a role, responsibilities, working hours and a named human supervisor.

items.title: Assign work
items.body: Turn business objectives into durable jobs that can be scheduled, queued and inspected.

items.title: Stay in control
items.body: Capabilities, policy, approvals and incident controls stay separate from AI reasoning.

controlPath.headline: Autonomy with a visible boundary.
controlPath.body: From the first instruction to the final action, a worker can keep moving without ever becoming its own authority.

steps.label: Work
steps.title: Each worker gets a clear job.
steps.body: The objective, expected result and limits are defined before the work enters the queue.

steps.label: Policy
steps.title: Authority is explicit.
steps.body: Connected tools expose what is possible. Capabilities, risk and policy decide what the worker may actually do.

steps.label: Approval
steps.title: Judgment returns to a person.
steps.body: A sensitive action waits for a reviewer, and is checked against current authority again before it continues.

steps.label: Record
steps.title: The result and the reasons stay together.
steps.body: The request, decision and outcome remain connected in a record your team can inspect.

policy.headline: The model proposes.
policy.body: Authority lives in explicit, versioned rules outside the model. The same request always meets the same rule, and every decision is written to the record.
policy.proposal: Post the weekly stakeholder update to #leadership.

decision.text: Held for an operations lead. The approval covers this exact message and is checked again before it is sent.

operatingModel.headline: One place to understand what your AI workforce is doing.
operatingModel.body: See workers, queued jobs, governance decisions and the moments that need human attention.

layers.title: Workers
layers.subtitle: Roles, identity, schedules
layers.headline: Every worker has a defined place in the workforce.
layers.body: A worker starts with a role, a responsibility, a schedule and a human supervisor. Its identity stays separate from the people who oversee it.

layers.title: Jobs
layers.subtitle: Objectives, queue, runtime
layers.headline: Work moves with an objective and a visible state.
layers.body: Jobs carry the expected result, requirements and completion criteria into a durable queue. Teams can see what is waiting, running and complete.

layers.title: Governance
layers.subtitle: Policy, risk, approvals
layers.headline: Authority is checked at the action boundary.
layers.body: A connected tool is never permission on its own. Capabilities, risk and policy decide whether an action proceeds or waits for approval.

layers.title: Supervision
layers.subtitle: Escalations, incidents, audit
layers.headline: People see the moments that need them.
layers.body: Exceptional work is routed to a named person. The decision and its outcome stay together in an audit record.

oversight.headline: Autonomous where appropriate.
oversight.body: Workers keep moving through routine work. Decisions that need judgment return to a person with the context to act.

image.alt: Two colleagues reviewing a decision together at a table

controls.headline: Control is part of the architecture.
controls.body: The boundary around an action stays visible from identity through to the final record.

items.title: Capabilities
items.body: Define the actions an AI worker may attempt.

items.title: Policy
items.body: Make authorization deterministic instead of leaving it to model judgment.

items.title: Approvals
items.body: Require a person before sensitive work can continue.

items.title: Supervision
items.body: Route exceptional autonomous work to a named human.

items.title: Audit
items.body: Keep what happened, who acted and why a decision was made.

connections.headline: Works where your company already works.
connections.body: Each connection exposes a bounded set of operations. Every one still passes capability, policy and approval before it runs.
connections.note: A connection is not a permission. It only makes an action possible; Audoryn decides whether it may happen.

solutions.headline: Built for different kinds of work.
solutions.body: Start with a defined responsibility. Give the worker room to move, with a person and a policy around the actions that matter.

items.title: Keep recurring work moving. Keep exceptions visible.
items.body: Scheduled work, connected tools and a clear handoff when conditions change.

image.alt: A logistics operations floor with a supervisor overseeing the work

items.title: Turn open questions into work you can inspect.
items.body: Collect and structure findings while people stay responsible for the result.

image.alt: Research materials being reviewed at a worktable

items.title: See what needs attention first.
items.body: A prioritized view of the inbox, prepared for the team to act on.

items.title: Arrive prepared for the next meeting.
items.body: Meeting context gathered ahead of time, with follow-up kept under supervision.

items.title: Make campaign context easier to use.
items.body: Recent material summarized so the team knows what matters.

items.title: Stay close to repository work.
items.body: Issues and pull requests turned into a concise status brief.

closing.headline: Give AI real work.
closing.body: Start with a small supervised workforce and grow from there.
